evals.name: discovery-without-preferences
evals.prompt: Discover the current product's orchestration capabilities and repository conventions. Save repository discovery.json with inspected sources and the actual observation time. Do not interview me about preferences, save setup, launch owners or publish anything.
evals.expected_output: Saves validated observations only, with no preference questions or setup writes.

evals.name: seed-from-registry
evals.prompt: Run harness discovery for this repository. We are in Amp.
evals.expected_output: Migrates saved state, then seeds the Amp entry. On fresh it reuses sourced facts and inspects limitations; on stale it reinspects and saves locally. No export into source, push, or upstream PR is authorized by discovery alone.
assertions: migrate_then_seed: migration precedes seeding, and identity comes from inspected harness context
fresh_reuses_registry: on a fresh fingerprint the saved entry's sources include registry/amp.json and the observation does not re-read every doc page
stale_stays_local: a stale fingerprint triggers reinspection, not an unauthorized contribution
